intro: This plan is **selective on purpose**: it schedules the high-yield part of the site (must-do problems, frequently asked questions, the senior topics product companies probe in 2026-27) and leaves the rest as optional depth. Each day has **DSA**, a **core** block, a **design** topic and one **trap** (a question most people get wrong). Interview-round playbooks appear on the day their material starts. Long days (6th and 7th of each week) carry more and an optional AI lesson. The last week before revision is lighter on purpose: use it to catch up. Tick tasks as you go; the **Daily Routine** page tracks your streak. After day 60, move to the **Final Round**.
hoursPerDay: About 2-4 hours on normal days and 3.5-6 on long days (optional AI lessons not counted). If a day runs over, finish it the next morning; the dashboard tracks what is pending.

weeks.title: Foundations
weeks.goal: Arrays, hashing, two pointers, sliding window; Core Java; how design interviews work; fix your resume.

weeks.title: Java depth and concurrency
weeks.goal: Stacks, binary search, linked lists; collections, JVM, practical concurrency; caching, sharding.

weeks.title: Spring and data
weeks.goal: Trees, tries, heaps; Spring Boot, JPA, transactions; SQL and InnoDB; replication and consistency.

weeks.title: Distributed systems
weeks.goal: Backtracking and graphs; microservices; queues, APIs, rate limiting; first LLD and case studies. Start applying.

weeks.title: Senior signals
weeks.goal: Graphs and DP; production debugging, performance, testing and code review; senior design topics.

weeks.title: Breadth that gets asked
weeks.goal: DP, greedy, intervals; behavioral stories, security, cloud, AI-assisted engineering; machine coding.

weeks.title: Interview mode
weeks.goal: Remaining patterns and re-solves; Angular, JS and networking essentials; mocks every few days.

weeks.title: Polish
weeks.goal: Re-solve must-dos; behavioral and leadership stories; LLD practice; mocks.

weeks.title: Final revision
weeks.goal: Re-solve, flashcards, the focus list, mocks. Then start the 14-day Final Round.
